Ticket board · coffee-vision · every ticket

Every ticket, where it stands, and its plan

One row per ticket, newest first in each table, generated from the tickets at every commit: the title is the ticket’s short title and the status the text of its Status pill. What is done, with dates and commits, is in the ticket. Do not edit this page: change the ticket, and the commit brings its row here (coffeecv/ticket_board.py, ADR 0039).
